summary: Sandbach United's preseason is ramping up with an exciting new squad for 2026-27, featuring fresh signings and returning players as they prepare for their promotion push. While they fell short against St Helens in a closely contested friendly, the Ramblers are just one week away from kickoff with three brand new kits and are actively seeking sponsorship partners. With player details starting to emerge and plenty of positive momentum building, it's a great time for fans to get behind the team!
